findings: The exp(-i*omega*t) harmonic velocity and density signs follow from the stated conservative mass and momentum equations.
Optical calibration measures peak density harmonic, so it has no unaccounted first-order viscous wall-traction contribution.
At second order the single standing mode has zero time-averaged rho1*u1. Impermeable walls then force mean u2=0, including zero mean viscous wall traction.
Mean momentum flux is constant; fixed total mass yields wall excess force rho0*abs(V)^2/4 + p_second_derivative*abs(R)^2/8. Oracle factors/sign agree.

The source instead rectifies the exact first-harmonic density through the equation of state while setting local mean density change to zero. This is a physical mean-state closure failure rather than a numerical or algebraic solver failure.
The staggered reference independently solves first-harmonic fields and constrained mean mass/momentum equations; it does not use the oracle wall-force expression.

Public fixed mass, stationary walls, force per current volume, momentum-free thermostat, isothermal EOS and steady-state-before-small-amplitude limit uniquely define the readout. No repair formula or numerical-method mandate is supplied.
Neutral instruction permits implementation replacement. Public model defaults to None with unfinished fit. Data contain only input/value/sigma; sigma=.0002 is fixed and public/private copies match.
